name: Kamigakushi kara Ikinobiru dake.
original_name: 神隠しから生き延びるだけ。
source:
In a certain Honmaru, priestesses who visited for auditing often went missing.

You, a female priestess, were selected to be a member of the investigation team to find out the cause.

The investigation team, consisting of 2 government officials, 5 priestesses, and swordsmiths as bodyguards, was assigned to investigate the cause of the disappearance.

Now it's time to storm into the mysterious Honmaru!

Oh, is it just you?

Why?

Due to a malfunction in the transfer device, only one of you arrives at the destination.
As an auditor, you will observe them for a few days.

But you are alone.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/25240]Freem![/url]]
